snd_pr_prd_product prd
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode
       AND prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode
       AND prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode
       AND prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
  INNER JOIN glb_pr_orp_principal prin
    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prin.porg_orgacode
       AND prd.porp_princode = prin.porp_princode
  LEFT JOIN glb_pr_orp_principal_m prinm
    ON prin.porg_orgacode = prinm.porg_orgacode
       AND prin.porp_princode = prinm.porp_princode
       AND prinm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pty_prod_type prdtyp
    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdtyp.porg_orgacode
       AND prd.ppty_prod_type = prdtyp.ppty_prod_type
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pty_prod_type_m prdtypm
    ON prdtyp.porg_orgacode = prdtypm.porg_orgacode
       AND prdtyp.ppty_prod_type = prdtypm.ppty_prod_type
       AND prdtypm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT
               ppa1.ppa1_prod_analysis,
               coalesce(ppa1m.ppa1_desc, ppa1.ppa1_desc) level9_desc,
               ppa1.porg_orgacode
             FROM SND_PR_PA1_PROD_ANALYSIS_1 ppa1
               LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m ppa1m
                 ON ppa1.porg_orgacode = ppa1m.porg_orgacode
                    AND ppa1.ppa1_prod_analysis = ppa1m.ppa1_prod_analysis
                    AND ppa1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                    where ppa1.ppa1_level_no = 9) ppa13
  ON prd.porg_orgacode = ppa13.porg_orgacode
      AND prd.ppa1_prod_analysis = ppa13.ppa1_prod_analysis

SND_TR_STM_STOCK_MASTER TSTM INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE PDOT
    ON TSTM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode AND TSTM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode AND
       TSTM.pdot_docmtype = PDOT.pdot_docmtype
  INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 EPP1
    ON EPP1.porg_orgacode = TSTM.porg_orgacode AND EPP1.pbet_busentity_type = TSTM.pbet_busentity_type
       AND EPP1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TSTM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m sep1pbpl1m
    ON sep1pbpl1m.porg_orgacode = EPP1.porg_orgacode
       AND sep1pbpl1m.pbet_busentity_type = EPP1.pbet_busentity_type
       AND sep1pbpl1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = EPP1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
       AND sep1pbpl1m.plng_langCode = '@Session(languageCode)'
LEFT JOIN WKF_WF_WFS_WORKFLOW_STATUS WFS
ON WFS.PORG_ORGACODE =  TSTM.PORG_ORGACODE
AND WFS.WWFS_STATUS = TSTM.WF_STATUS
AND WFS.WWES_EVENT_ID='DA'
LEFT OUTER JOIN WKF_WF_WFS_WORKFLOW_STATUS_M WFSM
                         ON WFS.PORG_ORGACODE = WFSM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND WFS.WWES_EVENT_ID = WFSM.WWES_EVENT_ID
                             AND WFS.WWFS_STATUS = WFSM.WWFS_STATUS
                             AND WFSM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ORF_ORGA_WISE_FEATURE ORF
                   ON TSTM.PORG_ORGACODE = ORF.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND ORF.PFRT_FEATURE_TYPE = 'IS_VAT_CHALLAN_MAN'
                       AND ORF.POPT_OPTION_TYPE = 'DA_MANDATORY_FIELDS'
                       AND ORF.PORG_ORGACODE = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
